Description: Stackurity read-only access (template v1). Creates an IAM role that Stackurity assumes with your connection's external ID to read RDS, Aurora, ElastiCache, EKS, Lambda and OpenSearch versions, and optionally to install the Stackurity agent on EC2 instances through SSM Run Command.

Label.default: Filled in by Stackurity: do not change

CallbackUrl.default: Where the stack reports the role ARN (empty: paste it yourself)

EnableAgentInstall.default: Allow installing the Stackurity agent on EC2 instances through SSM

StackurityPrincipal.default: Stackurity's AWS principal (trusted to assume the role)

RoleArn.Description: Paste this into Stackurity if it did not pick the role up by itself

CallbackToken.Description: Signed, single-use token that ties the report to this connection.

CallbackUrl.Description: Stackurity's HTTPS address for the role ARN. Leave empty to paste the ARN from the outputs instead.

EnableAgentInstall.Description: true adds ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation, ssm:GetCommandInvocation and ssm:SendCommand (AWS-RunShellScript only).

ExternalId.ConstraintDescription: the external ID Stackurity shows for this connection
ExternalId.Description: Generated by Stackurity for this connection; the role can only be assumed with it.

StackurityPrincipal.ConstraintDescription: an IAM user, role or account root ARN
StackurityPrincipal.Description: ARN of the IAM user or role Stackurity calls AWS with, or arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:root.

Properties.Description: Reports the Stackurity role ARN to Stackurity once, when the stack is created
Lets the Stackurity callback function write its logs
Read-only access for Stackurity (external ID required)
